scenarios.title: Winery
scenarios.description: Follow grape handling, extraction, fermentation vessels and bottling, with a separately labeled illustrative effluent-energy branch.

experiments.title: Stop grape receiving belt
experiments.expected: Upstream supply stops. Connected downstream flow should fall as any demonstration buffers are consumed; other views show the same change.
experiments.limitation: The delay is a generic inventory/response rule, not residence-time or biological calibration.

experiments.title: Close cellar transfer valve
experiments.expected: Transfer through the valve stops. Upstream buffers/pressure may rise and downstream inventory may fall under the toy model.
experiments.limitation: Pressure indices do not represent real equipment ratings or safety limits.

experiments.title: Overload grape crusher
experiments.expected: Requested load exceeds the edited demonstration capacity. Observe warning/damage accumulation and reduced downstream throughput while the shared clock advances.
experiments.limitation: Thresholds and damage progression are fictional, editable playground rules.

experiments.title: Break grape crusher
experiments.expected: The selected stage shows damage/fault and loses availability; dependent streams react while unrelated branches remain inspectable.
experiments.limitation: This is an injected toy failure, not equipment failure-mode analysis.

experiments.title: Trip the demonstration power source
experiments.expected: Explicitly supplied equipment loses power availability. Inspect both process and utility views to see the shared dependency.
experiments.limitation: No electrical protection coordination, grid dynamics or real isolation procedure is modeled.
